entity_types.name: Complaint
entity_types.description: A safety-related problem or failure report submitted by a vehicle owner to NHTSA, excluding general feedback or customer service inquiries.

entity_types.name: Recall
entity_types.description: An official safety recall campaign or stop-sale action issued to address a vehicle safety defect, excluding routine technical service bulletins.

entity_types.name: Vehicle
entity_types.description: A specific make, model, and model year of an automobile, excluding generic classes of vehicles.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: A distinct mechanical, electrical, structural, or software part or assembly of a vehicle, excluding entire vehicles and external objects.

entity_types.name: Problem
entity_types.description: A specific functional failure, abnormal symptom, or safety hazard experienced in a vehicle, distinct from the physical part itself.

fact_types.description: Connects an owner complaint to a specific malfunction, symptom, or safety hazard experienced.
Links a complaint to a specific vehicle part or assembly mentioned by the owner or service technician.
Identifies an official recall or stop-sale campaign cited within an owner complaint.
Identifies the specific vehicle model and year that is the subject of the complaint.
Associates a reported failure symptom or defect condition with the vehicle component that failed or malfunctioned.
Indicates that one reported failure condition or symptom triggers or results in another hazard or failure.
Identifies the vehicle component that an official safety recall targets for repair, inspection, or replacement.
Specifies the safety hazard, symptom, or failure mode that the recall campaign is designed to rectify.
Identifies the vehicle model and year impacted by the safety recall campaign.
Specifies that a smaller part belongs structurally or functionally to a larger vehicle subsystem.
Connects a vehicle component to the vehicle model featured in the document context.
